title: Scalable GEOINT Architecture IT Contractor Manpower Equivalent (CME) Support
description: Request for Proposal W50NH9-27-R-A006 for Scalable Geospatial Intelligence (GEOINT) Architecture IT Contractor Manpower Equivalent support for U.S. Army Intelligence and Security Command (INSCOM). Proposals due Nov 13, 2026 with a proposal validity of at least 240 days. Period of performance: one 30-day transition-in, a 12-month base, four 12-month options and one six-month option. Estimated award date Jan 11, 2027. Primarily time and materials, evaluated on a best value trade-off basis.
